_written: 2026-11-05, before any variant in these five windows was retrieved or counted. Same definitions as the promoter variant census (tools/promoter_variant_census/rules.json, approved 2026-11-04) unless stated here. AlphaGenome deferred (user: run the other sources first).
windows: windows.tsv (1-based inclusive hg38), from the user 2026-11-05: CARD11 chr7:3042999-3044186, JAK1 chr1:64965924-64966998, JAK3 chr19:17847600-17848217, STAT1 chr2:191013736-191014488, STAT3 chr17:42387768-42389130. All five genes are on the minus strand; TSS and transcript as given by the user (each TSS = PromoterAI file tss_pos + 1 for that transcript). Offsets: upstream negative.
denominator: all possible SNVs = 3 x window length
gnomad: as census: v4.1 genomes PASS (primary); SNV vs indel; indel-in-window rule; AF > 1% overall and in any ancestry group with AN >= 2000. Also reported: exome-only variants, and the joint genomes + exomes AF (AC sum / AN sum, as Figure 3 panel b) for every variant
gtex: as census: GTEx V10 significant single-tissue eQTL for the window's gene (significant / tested, not significant (maf01) / not tested); significant for any gene (V10 per-variant lookup); V8 significant and V8 fine-mapped for the target gene. Also: every significant V10 target-gene eQTL anywhere in the window regardless of gnomAD, and the nearest V10 target-gene eQTL to the TSS

promoterai.transcript: the window's transcript (windows.tsv); max |score| over all transcripts of the gene as a sensitivity column
promoterai.coverage: the file scores only TSS +/- 500 bp per transcript; window positions outside that range for the window's transcript are reported as not scored (not counted as no effect)
promoterai.large_effect: |score| >= 0.1, >= 0.2 and >= 0.5 (PromoterAI README thresholds), split by sign (negative = predicted lower expression)

clinvar._written: 2026-11-05, after the gnomAD/GTEx/PromoterAI scan results had been seen (user: add ClinVar before AlphaGenome) and before ClinVar was queried
clinvar.source: NCBI E-utilities esearch <chrom>[chr] AND <start>:<end>[chrpos38] per window + esummary (census fetch.py clinvar)
clinvar.classes: as tools/promoter_variant_census/truth_set_rules.json: P/LP = germline Pathogenic, Likely pathogenic or Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic (not Conflicting), any review status; B/LB likewise; VUS, conflicting and other counted alongside. Small variants = SPDI change <= 50 bp lying in the window (SNVs and indels separately); longer or no-SPDI records counted as structural, not in the small counts
clinvar.reported: per window counts by class and review status; overlap of ClinVar B/LB with the candidate benign SNVs and of ClinVar P/LP with common (B1) SNVs; ClinVar class per gnomAD variant in variants.tsv and common.tsv

candidate_benign: B1 (AF > 1% any group) and B2 (not a V10 eQTL for the target gene; not tested passes and is flagged; strict version requires tested) and PromoterAI |score| < 0.1. AlphaGenome not yet applied, so these are provisional; ClinVar is context, not a filter
outputs: results/immune_promoter_scan_20261105/: raw pulls (gnomad/, gtex/, promoterai/, reference/), variants.tsv (one row per gnomAD variant), all_snvs.tsv (every possible SNV with PromoterAI), counts.tsv (per window), common.tsv (AF > 1% any group), eqtl_target.tsv (V10 target-gene eQTLs in or near the windows), summary.json

tert._written: 2026-11-05, user asked to run the same analyses on the TERT promoter; before any TERT variant was retrieved
tert.window: windows_tert.tsv: chr5:1294953-1295254 (302 bp, from the user), minus strand, TSS 1295068 = MANE Select ENST00000310581 / NM_198253.3 (PromoterAI tss_pos + 1; offsets -186..+115). The other TERT transcript in the PromoterAI file (ENST00000334602) only enters the max-over-transcripts column
tert.rules: identical to the five immune promoters (gnomAD, GTEx with target gene TERT, PromoterAI, ClinVar); output results/tert_promoter_scan_20261105/
tert.note: ClinVar here may include somatic records (TERT promoter hotspots); only the germline classification is used, as everywhere
